g.text: EPFL | Best training score by equivalent tokens
Cumulative token cost · both workers summed at each completed round
EvE Appendix A.1: equivalent tokens = cached input + 2 × fresh input + 12 × output.
Dots mark completed rounds. All four configurations completed 20 rounds; each point sums both workers.
B includes 499,012 interruption tokens before round 6. Fixed paper weights; not a model-specific bill. Training only.
